NovaStars.title: Nova Stars v1.0
NovaStars.author: Key's Artworks
NovaStars.description: You find the game too easy or not challenging enough? Well this is the mod for you! This adds new stars that are very hard to get and requires very high-skill! (You must have collected all 120 stars before getting these) Rules for the stars are very simple... - You are only allowed to use your own skills - NO CHEATS! Whatsoever! Creator: Key's Artworks Coder: Blocky Contibutors: ColbyRayz!, Sunk, 6b, ShwetunlinYT There's also a secret collectible too! Hope you can find it! It's very Squishy
